sql_query:
WITH reviews AS (
  SELECT
    rv.review_id,
    rv.order_id,
    rv.review_score,
    o.order_delivered_customer_date::date AS delivered_date,
    o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date AS estimated_date,
    oi.order_price_avg
  FROM order_reviews rv
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = rv.order_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      oi.order_id,
      AVG(oi.price) AS order_price_avg
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.order_id
  ) oi ON oi.order_id = rv.order_id
),
price_terciles AS (
  SELECT
    review_id,
    order_id,
    review_score,
    delivered_date,
    estimated_date,
    order_price_avg,
    NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(order_price_avg, 0)) AS price_tile
  FROM reviews
),
delivery_agg AS (
  SELECT
    'delivery_punctuality' AS factor,
    CASE WHEN delivered_date <= estimated_date THEN 'on_time' ELSE 'late' END AS factor_value,
    ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN review_score <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))::float / NULLIF(ABS(COUNT(review_id)),0) AS bad_review_rate,
    ABS(COUNT(review_id)) AS sample_size
  FROM reviews
  WHERE delivered_date IS NOT NULL AND estimated_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY CASE WHEN delivered_date <= estimated_date THEN 'on_time' ELSE 'late' END
),
price_agg AS (
  SELECT
    'price_segment' AS factor,
    CASE price_tile WHEN 1 THEN 'low' WHEN 2 THEN 'medium' WHEN 3 THEN 'high' END AS factor_value,
    ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN review_score <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))::float / NULLIF(ABS(COUNT(review_id)),0) AS bad_review_rate,
    ABS(COUNT(review_id)) AS sample_size
  FROM price_terciles
  GROUP BY price_tile
),
category_agg_prep AS (
  SELECT
    pct.product_category_name_english AS category_eng,
    rv.review_id,
    rv.review_score
  FROM order_reviews rv
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = rv.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  LEFT JOIN product_category_translation pct ON pct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
  WHERE COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown') IS NOT NULL
),
category_counts AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(category_eng, 'Unknown') AS category_eng,
    ABS(COUNT(review_id)) AS review_count
  FROM category_agg_prep
  GROUP BY COALESCE(category_eng, 'Unknown')
  ORDER BY review_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
category_agg AS (
  SELECT
    'product_category' AS factor,
    cc.category_eng AS factor_value,
    ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN cap.review_score <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))::float / NULLIF(ABS(COUNT(cap.review_id)),0) AS bad_review_rate,
    ABS(COUNT(cap.review_id)) AS sample_size
  FROM category_agg_prep cap
  JOIN category_counts cc ON cc.category_eng = cap.category_eng
  GROUP BY cc.category_eng
)
SELECT factor, factor_value, bad_review_rate, sample_size
FROM delivery_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT factor, factor_value, bad_review_rate, sample_size
FROM price_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT factor, factor_value, bad_review_rate, sample_size
FROM category_agg
ORDER BY factor, factor_value;
